findings.explanation: This clause requires you to perform unspecified future work for free, which can severely drain your time and resources without any added compensation.
findings.suggested_change: Delete this clause or modify it to state that any out-of-scope services will be billed separately at your standard hourly rate via a written change order.

findings.quoted_text: Client may request unlimited revisions until Client is fully satisfied with each Deliverable.
findings.explanation: An open-ended revision policy tied to subjective satisfaction prevents project completion and traps you in an endless loop of unpaid work.
findings.suggested_change: Specify a fixed number of revision rounds (e.g., two rounds) per deliverable and state that additional revisions require additional fees.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to collaborating, but I would like to request a couple of adjustments before signing. - Regarding the clause requiring extra services without extra charge, this would involve performing unspecified future work for free, so I propose modifying the relevant clause to state that any out-of-scope services will be billed separately at my standard hourly rate via a written change order. - Regarding the clause about unlimited revisions until full satisfaction, an open-ended revision policy can prevent project completion, so I propose specifying a fixed number of revision rounds per deliverable and stating that additional revisions require additional fees. Thank you for understanding.
